- name: asana__project_analytics
      description: Executive-level Asana project analytics with health, workload, schedule, scoring, ROI, maturity, priorities, and ranks; only valid projects are output
      grain: One row per project_id (valid records only)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - staging.stg_asana__team
      - intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators
      business_logic: 'Build analytics in stages: - Filter projects to those with a non-null project_name. - Join team details by team_id and health indicators by project_id. - Derive schedule metrics: - planned_duration_days: whole days from start (created_at) to deadline if a deadline exists; otherwise null. - elapsed_days: whole days from start to today. - remaining_days: whole days from today to deadline if a deadline exists; otherwise null. - completion_rate_per_day: completion_percentage divided by elapsed_days, rounded to 4 decimals; null if elapsed_days is not positive. - Resource/workload metrics: - avg_tasks_per_assignee: if total_tasks > 0, divide total_tasks by max(1, unique_assignees) and round to 2 decimals; if unique_assignees is null in this case, the result is null; otherwise 0. - team_size_category by unique_assignees: 0 → no_team; 1 → solo_project; 2–3 → small_team; 4–7 → medium_team; 8–15 → large_team; else enterprise_team (null maps to enterprise_team). - project_size_category by total_tasks: 0–5 → micro_project; 6–20 → small_project; 21–50 → medium_project; 51–100 → large_project; else enterprise_project (null maps to enterprise_project). - estimated_days_to_completion: when completion_rate_per_day > 0 and completion_percentage < 100, (100 − completion_percentage) divided by completion_rate_per_day, rounded up to whole days; otherwise null. - schedule_forecast: if completion_rate_per_day > 0 and completion_percentage < 100, compare estimated_days_to_completion to remaining_days: ≤ remaining_days → on_schedule; ≤ remaining_days × 1.2 → slight_delay; ≤ remaining_days × 1.5 → moderate_delay; else significant_delay. Otherwise, if completion_percentage = 100 → completed; else if remaining_days < 0 → overdue; else uncertain. - Performance scoring: - efficiency_score (0–25): by completion_rate_per_day thresholds, inclusive bands: ≥2.0 → 25; ≥1.0 → 20; ≥0.5 → 15; ≥0.2 → 10; else 5; then constrained to 0–25. - time_management_score (0–25): by schedule_forecast mapping: on_schedule 25; slight_delay 20; moderate_delay 15; significant_delay 10; overdue 5; else 12; constrained to 0–25. - collaboration_score (0–25): by avg_tasks_per_assignee and team size: if avg between 3 and 8 (inclusive) and unique_assignees ≥ 2 → 25; if avg between 2 and 12 → 20; if avg between 1 and 15 → 15; if unique_assignees ≥ 1 → 10; else 5; constrained to 0–25. - complexity_factor: enterprise_project 1.2; large_project 1.1; medium_project 1.0; small_project 0.9; micro_project 0.8. - Final analytics: - comprehensive_project_score: weighted sum of health (40%), efficiency (25%), time (20%), and collaboration (15%), multiplied by complexity_factor and rounded to 2 decimals. - roi_efficiency_ratio: if unique_assignees > 0 and elapsed_days > 0, compute (completion_percentage × quality_percentage ÷ 100) divided by (unique_assignees × elapsed_days ÷ 30), rounded to 3 decimals; otherwise 0. - project_maturity_phase by elapsed_days: ≤7 → startup_phase; ≤30 → early_development; ≤90 → active_development; ≤180 → mature_development; ≤365 → long_term_project; else legacy_project (null maps to legacy_project). - success_factors: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": high_health (overall_health_score ≥ 80), strong_progress (completion_percentage ≥ 75), quality_delivery (quality_percentage ≥ 70), low_risk (risk_percentage ≤ 15), good_collaboration (unique_assignees ≥ 3), on_time (schedule_forecast is on_schedule or completed); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - improvement_opportunities: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": improve_health (overall_health_score < 60), accelerate_progress (completion_percentage < 50 and elapsed_days > 30), enhance_quality (quality_percentage < 60), reduce_risks (risk_percentage > 25), balance_workload (avg_tasks_per_assignee > 10), address_delays (schedule_forecast is moderate_delay or significant_delay), expand_team (unique_assignees < 2 and total_tasks > 10); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - management_priority: immediate_attention if risk_level is high_risk or schedule_forecast is overdue; else high_priority if overall_health_score < 50 or schedule_forecast is significant_delay; else monitor if overall_health_score ≥ 80 and schedule_forecast is on_schedule; otherwise regular_review. - Validation and ranking: - is_valid_record is true only when: project_id and project_name are present; comprehensive_project_score is between 0 and 120 inclusive; completion_percentage, quality_percentage, and risk_percentage are each between 0 and 100 inclusive; total_tasks and completed_tasks are not negative; and completed_tasks does not exceed total_tasks. - Ranks are computed across all rows before filtering: overall_performance_rank by comprehensive_project_score descending; health_rank by overall_health_score descending; progress_rank by completion_percentage descending; efficiency_rank by roi_efficiency_ratio descending. Ties share the same rank with gaps. - Output: return only rows where is_valid_record is true, ordered by comprehensive_project_score descending, then overall_health_score descending, then project_id ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier from Asana; grouping key with at most one output row per project_id
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from source; rows with null project_name are excluded
      - name: team_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Team identifier associated with the project; null if no matching team
      - name: team_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team name joined by team_id; null if no match
      - name: project_owner
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner user identifier from the project record (no user lookup applied)
      - name: project_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current project status from the source (passthrough)
      - name: project_start_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Project start timestamp from created_at
      - name: project_deadline
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Project due date timestamp; may be null
      - name: total_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total task count from health indicators; must be nonnegative for validity
      - name: completed_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Completed task count from health indicators; must be between 0 and total_tasks
      - name: active_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Active or in-progress task count from health indicators; may be null
      - name: overdue_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Past-due, incomplete task count from health indicators; may be null
      - name: unique_assignees
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct assignee count from health indicators; 0 means no assignees; may be null
      - name: completion_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent of tasks completed from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: quality_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent meeting quality criteria from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: risk_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent flagged as risky from health indicators; expected 0–100 for validity
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Overall health score from health indicators used in composite scoring
      - name: health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Health grade label from health indicators
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Risk level label from health indicators (e.g., high_risk)
      - name: project_forecast
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Forecast label from health indicators, distinct from schedule_forecast
      - name: focus_areas
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Focus areas text from health indicators
      - name: planned_duration_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from start to deadline; null if no deadline
      - name: elapsed_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days since start; null if start date is null
      - name: remaining_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days until deadline; negative if overdue; null if no deadline
      - name: completion_rate_per_day
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completion percentage per day since start, rounded to 4 decimals; null if elapsed_days is not positive
      - name: avg_tasks_per_assignee
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If total_tasks > 0, total_tasks divided by max(1, unique_assignees) rounded to 2 decimals (null if unique_assignees is null); otherwise 0
      - name: team_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Team size bucket by unique_assignees: no_team, solo_project, small_team, medium_team, large_team, or enterprise_team (null maps to enterprise_team)'
      - name: project_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Project size bucket by total_tasks: micro_project, small_project, medium_project, large_project, or enterprise_project (null maps to enterprise_project)'
      - name: estimated_days_to_completion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Remaining percent divided by daily completion rate and rounded up when rate > 0 and completion < 100; otherwise null
      - name: schedule_forecast
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Outlook: on_schedule, slight_delay, moderate_delay, significant_delay, completed, overdue, or uncertain based on thresholds and gating rules'
      - name: efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from completion_rate_per_day thresholds, constrained to 0–25
      - name: time_management_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from schedule_forecast mapping, constrained to 0–25
      - name: collaboration_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0–25 score from avg_tasks_per_assignee and team size, constrained to 0–25
      - name: complexity_factor
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: 'Multiplier by project_size_category: micro 0.8, small 0.9, medium 1.0, large 1.1, enterprise 1.2'
      - name: comprehensive_project_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Weighted health (40%), efficiency (25%), time (20%), and collaboration (15%) scaled by complexity and rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: roi_efficiency_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Efficiency of progress and quality relative to team size and time, rounded to 3 decimals; 0 when team size or elapsed_days is not positive
      - name: project_maturity_phase
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle phase by elapsed_days: startup_phase, early_development, active_development, mature_development, long_term_project, or legacy_project'
      - name: success_factors
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated tokens for strong signals in a fixed order; trailing comma and space removed; empty string if none
      - name: improvement_opportunities
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated tokens for weak signals in a fixed order; trailing comma and space removed; empty string if none
      - name: management_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority recommendation: immediate_attention, high_priority, monitor, or regular_review based on risk, health, and schedule'
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True only when all validation checks pass; output includes only true rows
      - name: overall_performance_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank by comprehensive_project_score descending across all rows before filtering; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: health_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank by overall_health_score descending across all rows before filtering; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: progress_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank by completion_percentage descending across all rows before filtering; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: efficiency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank by roi_efficiency_ratio descending across all rows before filtering; ties share rank with gaps

equal_column_confirmation_queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST("quality_percentage" AS VARCHAR) IS DISTINCT FROM CAST("roi_efficiency_ratio" AS VARCHAR)),count(*) FILTER(WHERE "quality_percentage" IS NOT NULL AND "roi_efficiency_ratio" IS NOT NULL AND CAST("quality_percentage" AS VARCHAR)=CAST("roi_efficiency_ratio" AS VARCHAR)) FROM "mart"."asana__project_analytics"

output.equality_policy: exact CAST AS VARCHAR per row; no trim/case/numeric/date normalization; both NULL ignored; at least one nonnull equal row; one-sided NULL differs

alternatives.expression_sql: CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(p.created_at AS DATE), CAST(p.due_date AS DATE)) AS BIGINT)
CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(p.created_at AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT)
CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CURRENT_DATE, CAST(p.due_date AS DATE)) AS BIGINT)
CASE WHEN total_tasks > 0 AND NOT unique_assignees IS NULL THEN ROUND(CAST(total_tasks AS DOUBLE) / GREATEST(1, unique_assignees), 2) WHEN total_tasks > 0 THEN NULL ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN unique_assignees = 0 THEN 'no_team' WHEN unique_assignees = 1 THEN 'solo_project' WHEN unique_assignees <= 3 THEN 'small_team' WHEN unique_assignees <= 7 THEN 'medium_team' WHEN unique_assignees <= 15 THEN 'large_team' ELSE 'enterprise_team' END

CASE WHEN total_tasks <= 5 THEN 'micro_project' WHEN total_tasks <= 20 THEN 'small_project' WHEN total_tasks <= 50 THEN 'medium_project' WHEN total_tasks <= 100 THEN 'large_project' ELSE 'enterprise_project' END
CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day > 0 AND completion_percentage < 100 THEN CEIL((100 - completion_percentage) / completion_rate_per_day) END

CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day > 0 AND completion_percentage < 100 THEN CASE WHEN CEIL((100 - completion_percentage) / completion_rate_per_day) <= remaining_days THEN 'on_schedule' WHEN CEIL((100 - completion_percentage) / completion_rate_per_day) <= remaining_days * 1.2 THEN 'slight_delay' WHEN CEIL((100 - completion_percentage) / completion_rate_per_day) <= remaining_days * 1.5 THEN 'moderate_delay' ELSE 'significant_delay' END WHEN completion_percentage = 100 THEN 'completed' WHEN remaining_days < 0 THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'uncertain' END
CASE WHEN completion_rate_per_day >= 2 THEN 25 WHEN completion_rate_per_day >= 1 THEN 20 WHEN completion_rate_per_day >= 0.5 THEN 15 WHEN completion_rate_per_day >= 0.2 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END
CASE WHEN completion_percentage = 100 THEN 25 WHEN remaining_days < 0 THEN 5 ELSE 12 END

CASE WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND unique_assignees >= 2 THEN 25 WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 2 AND 12 THEN 20 WHEN avg_tasks_per_assignee BETWEEN 1 AND 15 THEN 15 WHEN unique_assignees >= 1 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END
CAST(CASE project_size_category WHEN 'enterprise_project' THEN 1.2 WHEN 'large_project' THEN 1.1 WHEN 'medium_project' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'small_project' THEN 0.9 ELSE 0.8 END AS DECIMAL(2, 1))
CAST(ROUND((overall_health_score * 0.4 + efficiency_score * 0.25 + time_management_score * 0.2 + collaboration_score * 0.15) * complexity_factor, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
CASE WHEN unique_assignees > 0 AND elapsed_days > 0 THEN ROUND((completion_percentage * quality_percentage / 100.0) / (unique_assignees * elapsed_days / 30.0), 3) ELSE 0 END

CASE WHEN elapsed_days <= 7 THEN 'startup_phase' WHEN elapsed_days <= 30 THEN 'early_development' WHEN elapsed_days <= 90 THEN 'active_development' WHEN elapsed_days <= 180 THEN 'mature_development' WHEN elapsed_days <= 365 THEN 'long_term_project' ELSE 'legacy_project' END

≥1.0 → 20; ≥0.5 → 15; ≥0.2 → 10; else 5; then constrained to 0–25. - time_management_score (0–25): by schedule_forecast mapping: on_schedule 25; slight_delay 20; moderate_delay 15; significant_delay 10; remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - improvement_opportunities: concatenate, in this order, any applicable tokens separated by ", ": improve_health (overall_health_score < 60), accelerate_progress (completion_percentage < 50 and elapsed_days > 30), enhance_quality (quality_percentage < 60), reduce_risks (risk_percentage > 25), balance_workload (avg_tasks_per_assignee > 10), address_delays (schedule_forecast is moderate_delay or significant_delay), expand_team (unique_assignees < 2 and total_tasks > 10); remove any trailing comma and space; empty string if none. - management_priority: immediate_attention if risk_level is high_risk or schedule_forecast is overdue; else high_priority if overall_health_score < 50 or schedule_forecast is significant_delay; else monitor if overall_health_score ≥ 80 and schedule_forecast is on_schedule; otherwise regular_review. - Validation and ranking: - is_valid_record is true only when: project_id and project_name are present; comprehensive_project_score is between 0 and 120 inclusive; completion_percentage, quality_percentage, and risk_percentage are each between 0 and 100 inclusive; total_tasks and completed_tasks are not negative; and completed_tasks does not exceed total_tasks. - Ranks are computed across all rows before filtering: overall_performance_rank by comprehensive_project_score descending; health_rank by overall_health_score descending; progress_rank by completion_percentage descending; efficiency_rank by roi_efficiency_ratio descending. - name: asana__tag
      description: Tag attributes joined with the per-tag count of task_tag rows.
      grain: One row per row in staging.stg_asana__tag; duplicate tag_id values are preserved.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__tag
      - staging.stg_asana__task_tag
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in staging.stg_asana__tag; values are passed through with duplicates and NULLs preserved. - From staging.stg_asana__task_tag, compute per-tag usage by grouping on tag_id and counting all rows; no filtering and duplicates are counted. - Left join the tag rows to the usage metrics on tag_id, aligning types by converting the metrics tag_id to text to match the tag tag_id. - Keep every tag row; if no matching metric exists (including when tag_id is NULL or unmatched), set number_of_tasks to 0. - Output tag attributes (tag_id, tag_name, color, created_at, tag_notes, workspace_id) along with number_of_tasks; no additional transformations or sorting.'
      columns:
      - name: tag_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tag identifier from staging.stg_asana__tag; used to join to task counts after aligning types; NULLs are preserved.
      - name: tag_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name from staging.stg_asana__tag; passed through with NULLs preserved.
      - name: color
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Color value from staging.stg_asana__tag; passed through with NULLs preserved.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp from staging.stg_asana__tag; passed through with NULLs preserved.
      - name: tag_notes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Notes field from staging.stg_asana__tag; passed through with NULLs preserved.
      - name: workspace_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Workspace identifier from staging.stg_asana__tag; passed through with NULLs preserved.
      - name: number_of_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows in staging.stg_asana__task_tag per tag_id; all rows counted, and set to 0 when no matching task_tag rows exist.

blocks.original_text:
- name: asana__task
      description: Task details joined with open-length metrics, present assignee details (when available), first modifier, comments, followers, tags, projects, and subtask parent; inner-joined to open_length.
      grain: One row per task_id present in staging.stg_asana__task and intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_assignee
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_first_modifier
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_comments
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_followers
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_tags
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_projects
      - intermediate.int_asana__subtask_parent
      business_logic: '- Start with all columns from staging.stg_asana__task. - Build task_link by concatenating "https://app.asana.com/0/0/" and task_id; if task_id is null, task_link is null. - Inner join to intermediate.int_asana__task_open_length on task_id; rows without a match are excluded. - Left join to intermediate.int_asana__task_first_modifier on task_id. - Left join to intermediate.int_asana__task_comments on task_id; if missing, number_of_comments defaults to 0, and conversation is null. - Left join to intermediate.int_asana__task_followers on task_id; if missing, number_of_followers defaults to 0, and followers is null. - Left join to intermediate.int_asana__task_tags on task_id; if missing, number_of_tags defaults to 0, and tags is null. - Left join to intermediate.int_asana__task_assignee filtered to rows where has_assignee is true; provides assignee_name and assignee_email when present. - Left join to intermediate.int_asana__subtask_parent using task_id matched to subtask_id; set is_subtask to true when a parent mapping exists, otherwise false. - Left join to intermediate.int_asana__task_projects on task_id; number_of_projects and project fields are passed through and may be null when missing. - When joining related models whose task_id is stored as a number, compare using the base task_id as text to align types. - Text aggregations (conversation, followers, tags, project_ids/names/sections) are taken as provided by their source models, with their original ordering, casing, and duplication preserved. - Grain note: The model expects one upstream row per task_id in each joined source; if any left-joined source has multiple rows per task_id, multiple output rows can result.'
      columns:
      - name: task_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary task identifier used for joins; included only when present in both the base task and open_length sources.
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Assignee user ID from the base task; may be null.
      - name: is_completed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when the task is marked complete in the base task.
      - name: completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the task was marked complete; null if not completed.
      - name: completed_by_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: User ID that completed the task from the base task; null if unknown.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Task creation timestamp from the base task.
      - name: due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Task due timestamp from the base task; null if not set.
      - name: modified_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Last modified timestamp from the base task.
      - name: task_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task name from the base task.
      - name: parent_task_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Parent task ID from the base task when this task is a subtask; null otherwise.
      - name: start_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Planned start timestamp from the base task; null if not set.
      - name: task_description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task description text from the base task.
      - name: workspace_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Workspace identifier from the base task.
      - name: task_link
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: URL built as https://app.asana.com/0/0/ plus task_id; null when task_id is null.
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee display name from int_asana__task_assignee filtered to has_assignee=true; null when absent.
      - name: assignee_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee email from int_asana__task_assignee filtered to has_assignee=true; null when absent.
      - name: days_open
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of days the task has been open from int_asana__task_open_length.
      - name: is_currently_assigned
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when int_asana__task_open_length indicates a current assignee exists.
      - name: has_been_assigned
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when int_asana__task_open_length indicates the task has ever been assigned.
      - name: days_since_last_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the most recent assignment from int_asana__task_open_length; null if never assigned.
      - name: days_since_first_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the first assignment from int_asana__task_open_length; null if never assigned.
      - name: last_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent assignment timestamp (no time zone) from int_asana__task_open_length; null if never assigned.
      - name: first_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First assignment timestamp (no time zone) from int_asana__task_open_length; null if never assigned.
      - name: first_modifier_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the first modifier from int_asana__task_first_modifier; null if unavailable.
      - name: first_modifier_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name of the first modifier from int_asana__task_first_modifier; null if unavailable.
      - name: conversation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comment text aggregation from int_asana__task_comments; null when no comments.
      - name: number_of_comments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Comment count from int_asana__task_comments, defaulting to 0 when the join is missing.
      - name: followers
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Follower list aggregation from int_asana__task_followers; null when none.
      - name: number_of_followers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Follower count from int_asana__task_followers, defaulting to 0 when the join is missing.
      - name: tags
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tag list aggregation from int_asana__task_tags; null when none.
      - name: number_of_tags
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Tag count from int_asana__task_tags, defaulting to 0 when the join is missing.
      - name: project_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifiers aggregation from int_asana__task_projects; null when none.
      - name: project_names
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project names aggregation from int_asana__task_projects; null when none.
      - name: projects_sections
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project sections aggregation from int_asana__task_projects; null when none.
      - name: number_of_projects
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Project count from int_asana__task_projects; null when the join is missing.

blocks.original_text:
- name: asana__task_lifecycle_analysis
      description: Deterministic lifecycle analytics per task with computed timings, classifications, pattern lists, and project/user context; outputs only records passing validation
      grain: One row per task_id per associated project (or one row if no project), after validation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_story
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task
      - staging.stg_asana__user
      business_logic: '1) Base rows: include tasks from staging.stg_asana__task where created_at is not null. 2) Join per-task metrics from intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics (task_status_category, performance_grade, health_score, response_time_days, delay_days, complexity_score, urgency_score, activity_score). 3) Build task stories from intermediate.int_asana__task_story where action_taken is not null and derive per task: - creation_timestamp: earliest ''created'' story, - first_assignment_timestamp: earliest ''assigned'' story, - last_assignment_timestamp: latest ''assigned'' story, - last_modification_timestamp: latest story across all actions, - completion_timestamp: earliest ''completed'' story, - Activity aggregates: total_story_events (count), unique_action_types (distinct action_taken), days_with_activity (distinct calendar dates of stories). 4) Compute lifecycle durations: - hours_to_assignment: hours from task.created_at to first_assignment_timestamp when first_assignment_timestamp exists; otherwise null, - hours_assigned_to_completion: hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at when both exist; otherwise null, - total_lifecycle_hours: hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at if completed, else to the current time, - avg_daily_activity_rate: if lifecycle days from task.created_at to task.completed_at or current time > 0, then total_story_events divided by that day count rounded to two decimals; otherwise equals total_story_events. 5) Classifications and scores: - lifecycle_efficiency_category: • If completed: ''highly_efficient'' when hours_to_assignment<=24 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''efficient'' when <=72 and <=336; ''moderate'' when <=168 and <=720; ''slow_start'' when hours_to_assignment<=336; ''slow_completion'' when hours_assigned_to_completion>720; else ''inefficient''. • If not completed: ''stalled_unassigned'' when hours_to_assignment is null and total_lifecycle_hours>168; ''stalled_assigned'' when hours_to_assignment is not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''urgent_delayed'' when urgency_score>=4 and total_lifecycle_hours>72; else ''in_progress''. - activity_level by avg_daily_activity_rate: >=2.0 ''very_active''; >=1.0 ''active''; >=0.5 ''moderate_activity''; >=0.1 ''low_activity''; else ''dormant''. - lifecycle_health_score: clamp to [0,100] the sum of: • Timeliness: completed on time=40; completed with delay_days<=2=30; <=7=20; completed late>7=10; if not completed and due_date>today=35; due today=25; overdue=5. • Response speed: response_time_days<=1=30; <=3=25; <=7=20; <=14=15; non-null else=10; null=5. • Activity: activity_score*4. • Complexity fit: complexity=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=168=10; complexity=2 and <=336=10; complexity=3 and <=720=10; any task <=72 hours=8; else=5. - current_lifecycle_stage: ''backlog'' (not completed and no assignee); ''newly_assigned'' (not completed, assignee exists, and within 1 day of first assignment or creation if assignment missing); ''active_development'' (not completed, assignee exists, and modified within 7 days); ''stagnant'' (not completed, assignee exists, and last modification >7 days); ''completed_on_time'' (completed with delay_days=0); ''completed_delayed'' (completed with delay_days>0); else ''unknown_state''. 6) Pattern lists (tokens evaluated in fixed order, joined by ", ", and trimmed; empty string if none): - anomaly_patterns: ''delayed_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>336; ''prolonged_execution'' if hours_assigned_to_completion>1440; ''dormant_task'' if avg_daily_activity_rate<0.1 and not completed; ''overengineered_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours>336; ''urgent_ignored'' if urgency_score>=4 and response_time_days>3; ''blocked_subtask'' if parent_task_id not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''severely_delayed'' if delay_days>14; ''high_churn'' if total_story_events>50. - success_patterns: ''fast_track'' if lifecycle_efficiency_category=''highly_efficient''; ''exemplary_execution'' if completed, on time, and performance_grade=''excellent''; ''consistent_progress'' if avg_daily_activity_rate>=1.0 and completed; ''rapid_delivery'' if response_time_days<=1 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''complex_mastery'' if complexity_score=3 and lifecycle_health_score>=80; ''urgent_success'' if urgency_score>=4 and delay_days=0. - improvement_opportunities: ''faster_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>72; ''increase_engagement'' if activity_level in (''low_activity'',''dormant''); ''improve_time_management'' if delay_days>0; ''enhance_responsiveness'' if response_time_days>3; ''overall_process_improvement'' if lifecycle_health_score<60; ''add_progress_updates'' if total_story_events<3 and not completed. - complexity_execution_match (first match wins): ''appropriate_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=72; ''appropriate_medium'' if complexity_score=2 and total_lifecycle_hours in 73–336; ''appropriate_complex'' if complexity_score=3 and total_lifecycle_hours in 337–720; ''faster_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours < complexity_score*72; ''slower_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours > complexity_score*240; else ''within_range''. 7) Project context: join staging.stg_asana__project_task on task_id, then staging.stg_asana__project left-joined to intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators to get project_name, team_id, and project_health_score (defaults to 50 when the project exists without indicators). Tasks with multiple projects yield one row per membership; tasks without a project retain a single row with null project fields. 8) User context: join staging.stg_asana__user by casting assignee_user_id to the user_id type to get assignee_name; assignee_performance_grade is always ''unknown'' for matched users. 9) Relative performance vs project: compare lifecycle_health_score to project_health_score and assign: >+20 ''above_project_average''; >+10 ''slightly_above_average''; >= -10 ''project_average''; >= -20 ''slightly_below_average''; else ''below_project_average'' (null project score falls into ''below_project_average''). 10) Data quality validation (is_valid_record): mark false when task_id or task_name is null; lifecycle_health_score outside [0,100]; any of total_lifecycle_hours, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, or avg_daily_activity_rate is negative; or is_completed=true while both completion_timestamp and completed_at are null. Only rows with is_valid_record=true are kept, and results are sorted by lifecycle_health_score descending, then total_lifecycle_hours ascending, then task_id.'
      columns:
      - name: task_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Asana task identifier; may repeat across rows if the task belongs to multiple projects
      - name: task_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Task display name from stg_asana__task
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Task creation timestamp from stg_asana__task; non-null by model filter
      - name: completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Task completion timestamp from stg_asana__task; null if not completed
      - name: due_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Due date from stg_asana__task; may be null and is compared to current date in scoring
      - name: is_completed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the task is marked completed in stg_asana__task
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current assignee user_id from stg_asana__task; may be null
      - name: parent_task_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Parent task_id when this is a subtask; null otherwise
      - name: task_status_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status category from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; passed through as-is
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Performance grade from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; used in success_patterns
      - name: health_score
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Health score from int_asana__task_performance_metrics; not recomputed here
      - name: response_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from creation to first response from metrics; used in scoring and patterns; null treated as worst in scoring
      - name: delay_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days completed past due date from metrics; used in scoring and patterns
      - name: complexity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Complexity score from metrics (integer); used in complexity matching and scoring
      - name: urgency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Urgency score from metrics (integer); used in efficiency and patterns
      - name: activity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity score from metrics (integer); contributes to lifecycle_health_score as activity_score*4
      - name: creation_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'created' story timestamp; may be null
      - name: first_assignment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'assigned' story timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: last_assignment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest 'assigned' story timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: last_modification_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest story timestamp across all actions; null if no stories
      - name: completion_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest 'completed' story timestamp; required when is_completed and completed_at is null
      - name: hours_to_assignment
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from task.created_at to first_assignment_timestamp; null if never assigned
      - name: hours_assigned_to_completion
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at; null if either timestamp is missing
      - name: total_lifecycle_hours
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at, or to the current time if not completed
      - name: total_story_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of all stories with non-null action_taken for the task
      - name: unique_action_types
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of action_taken values across stories for the task
      - name: days_with_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of calendar dates with any story activity
      - name: avg_daily_activity_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average stories per day across the lifecycle; rounded to 2 decimals when lifecycle days > 0, else equals total_story_events
      - name: lifecycle_efficiency_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Efficiency class based on completion status, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, total_lifecycle_hours, and urgency_score using ordered rules
      - name: activity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Activity class from avg_daily_activity_rate thresholds: very_active, active, moderate_activity, low_activity, dormant'
      - name: lifecycle_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Overall lifecycle score clamped to [0,100] from timeliness, response speed, activity_score*4, and complexity adaptation
      - name: current_lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage label from ordered rules: backlog, newly_assigned, active_development, stagnant, completed_on_time, completed_delayed, or unknown_state'
      - name: anomaly_patterns
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated anomaly tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: success_patterns
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated success tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: improvement_opportunities
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated improvement tokens in fixed order with trimming; empty string if none
      - name: complexity_execution_match
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Execution speed vs complexity classification with first-match priority: appropriate_simple/medium/complex, faster_than_expected, slower_than_expected, within_range'
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from stg_asana__project via project membership; null when no project
      - name: team_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Team ID from the associated project; null when no project
      - name: project_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Project overall health score (default 50 when project exists but no indicator); null when no project membership
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee user_name from stg_asana__user using the casted assignee_user_id join; null if no match
      - name: assignee_performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee performance grade from user context; set to 'unknown' for any matched user by design
      - name: relative_performance_vs_project
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Relative class vs project_health_score: above_project_average, slightly_above_average, project_average, slightly_below_average, below_project_average (null project treated as below_project_average)'
      - name: is_valid_record
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if all data quality checks pass; the final result set filters to is_valid_record=true

CASE WHEN is_completed THEN CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment <= 24 AND hours_assigned_to_completion <= 168 THEN 'highly_efficient' WHEN hours_to_assignment <= 72 AND hours_assigned_to_completion <= 336 THEN 'efficient' WHEN hours_to_assignment <= 168 AND hours_assigned_to_completion <= 720 THEN 'moderate' WHEN hours_to_assignment <= 336 THEN 'slow_start' WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion > 720 THEN 'slow_completion' ELSE 'inefficient' END WHEN hours_to_assignment IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours > 168 THEN 'stalled_unassigned' WHEN NOT hours_to_assignment IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours > 720 THEN 'stalled_assigned' WHEN urgency_score >= 4 AND total_lifecycle_hours > 72 THEN 'urgent_delayed' ELSE 'in_progress' END

CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 2 THEN 'very_active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 1 THEN 'active' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 0.5 THEN 'moderate_activity' WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 0.1 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'dormant' END

CAST(LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, (CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days = 0 THEN 40 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days <= 2 THEN 30 WHEN is_completed AND delay_days <= 7 THEN 20 WHEN is_completed THEN 10 WHEN CAST(due_date AS DATE) > CURRENT_DATE THEN 35 WHEN CAST(due_date AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE THEN 25 ELSE 5 END) + (CASE WHEN response_time_days <= 1 THEN 30 WHEN response_time_days <= 3 THEN 25 WHEN response_time_days <= 7 THEN 20 WHEN response_time_days <= 14 THEN 15 WHEN NOT response_time_days IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE 5 END) + COALESCE(activity_score, 1) * 4 + (CASE WHEN complexity_score = 1 AND total_lifecycle_hours <= 168 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score = 2 AND total_lifecycle_hours <= 336 THEN 10 WHEN complexity_score = 3 AND total_lifecycle_hours <= 720 THEN 10 WHEN total_lifecycle_hours <= 72 THEN 8 ELSE 5 END))) AS INT)

CASE WHEN NOT is_completed AND assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'backlog' WHEN NOT is_completed AND NOT assignee_user_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(first_assignment_timestamp, created_at) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1' DAY THEN 'newly_assigned' WHEN NOT is_completed AND NOT assignee_user_id IS NULL AND modified_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 'active_development' WHEN NOT is_completed AND NOT assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 'stagnant' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days = 0 THEN 'completed_on_time' WHEN is_completed AND delay_days > 0 THEN 'completed_delayed' ELSE 'unknown_state' END

CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment > 336 THEN 'delayed_assignment' END, CASE WHEN hours_assigned_to_completion > 1440 THEN 'prolonged_execution' END, CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate < 0.1 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'dormant_task' END, CASE WHEN complexity_score = 1 AND total_lifecycle_hours > 336 THEN 'overengineered_simple' END, CASE WHEN urgency_score >= 4 AND response_time_days > 3 THEN 'urgent_ignored' END, CASE WHEN NOT parent_task_id IS NULL AND total_lifecycle_hours > 720 THEN 'blocked_subtask' END, CASE WHEN delay_days > 14 THEN 'severely_delayed' END, CASE WHEN total_story_events > 50 THEN 'high_churn' END)

CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN lifecycle_efficiency_category = 'highly_efficient' THEN 'fast_track' END, CASE WHEN is_completed AND delay_days = 0 AND performance_grade = 'excellent' THEN 'exemplary_execution' END, CASE WHEN avg_daily_activity_rate >= 1 AND is_completed THEN 'consistent_progress' END, CASE WHEN response_time_days <= 1 AND hours_assigned_to_completion <= 168 THEN 'rapid_delivery' END, CASE WHEN complexity_score = 3 AND lifecycle_health_score >= 80 THEN 'complex_mastery' END, CASE WHEN urgency_score >= 4 AND delay_days = 0 THEN 'urgent_success' END)

CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN hours_to_assignment > 72 THEN 'faster_assignment' END, CASE WHEN activity_level IN ('low_activity', 'dormant') THEN 'increase_engagement' END, CASE WHEN delay_days > 0 THEN 'improve_time_management' END, CASE WHEN response_time_days > 3 THEN 'enhance_responsiveness' END, CASE WHEN lifecycle_health_score < 60 THEN 'overall_process_improvement' END, CASE WHEN total_story_events < 3 AND NOT is_completed THEN 'add_progress_updates' END)

CASE WHEN complexity_score = 1 AND total_lifecycle_hours <= 72 THEN 'appropriate_simple' WHEN complexity_score = 2 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 73 AND 336 THEN 'appropriate_medium' WHEN complexity_score = 3 AND total_lifecycle_hours BETWEEN 337 AND 720 THEN 'appropriate_complex' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours < complexity_score * 72 THEN 'faster_than_expected' WHEN total_lifecycle_hours > complexity_score * 240 THEN 'slower_than_expected' ELSE 'within_range' END
CAST(CASE WHEN p.project_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(h.overall_health_score, 50) END AS INT)
CASE WHEN NOT u.user_id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' END

CASE WHEN project_health_score IS NULL THEN 'below_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score - project_health_score > 20 THEN 'above_project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score - project_health_score > 10 THEN 'slightly_above_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score - project_health_score >= -10 THEN 'project_average' WHEN lifecycle_health_score - project_health_score >= -20 THEN 'slightly_below_average' ELSE 'below_project_average' END

otherwise null, - hours_assigned_to_completion: hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at when both exist; otherwise null, - total_lifecycle_hours: hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at if completed, else to the current time, - avg_daily_activity_rate: if lifecycle days from task.created_at to task.completed_at or current time > 0, then total_story_events divided by that day count rounded to two decimals; otherwise equals total_story_events. 5) Classifications and scores: - lifecycle_efficiency_category: • If completed: ''highly_efficient'' when hours_to_assignment<=24 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''efficient'' when <=72 and <=336; ''moderate'' when <=168 and <=720; ''slow_start'' when hours_to_assignment<=336; ''slow_completion'' when hours_assigned_to_completion>720; else ''inefficient''. • If not completed: ''stalled_unassigned'' when hours_to_assignment is null and total_lifecycle_hours>168; ''stalled_assigned'' when hours_to_assignment is not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''urgent_delayed'' when urgency_score>=4 and total_lifecycle_hours>72; else ''in_progress''. - activity_level by avg_daily_activity_rate: >=2.0 ''very_active''; >=1.0 ''active''; >=0.5 ''moderate_activity''; >=0.1 ''low_activity''; else ''dormant''. - lifecycle_health_score: clamp to [0,100] the sum of: • Timeliness: completed on time=40; completed with delay_days<=2=30; <=7=20; completed late>7=10; if not completed and due_date>today=35; due today=25; overdue=5. • Response speed: response_time_days<=1=30; <=3=25; <=7=20; <=14=15; non-null else=10; null=5. • Activity: activity_score*4. • Complexity fit: complexity=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=168=10; complexity=2 and <=336=10; complexity=3 and <=720=10; any task <=72 hours=8; else=5. - current_lifecycle_stage: ''backlog'' (not completed and no assignee); ''newly_assigned'' (not completed, assignee exists, and within 1 day of first assignment or creation if assignment missing); ''active_development'' (not completed, assignee exists, and modified within 7 days); ''stagnant'' (not completed, assignee exists, and last modification >7 days); ''completed_on_time'' (completed with delay_days=0); ''completed_delayed'' (completed with delay_days>0); else ''unknown_state''. 6) Pattern lists (tokens evaluated in fixed order, joined by ", ", and trimmed; empty string if none): - anomaly_patterns: ''delayed_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>336; ''prolonged_execution'' if hours_assigned_to_completion>1440; ''dormant_task'' if avg_daily_activity_rate<0.1 and not completed; ''overengineered_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours>336; ''urgent_ignored'' if urgency_score>=4 and response_time_days>3; ''blocked_subtask'' if parent_task_id not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''severely_delayed'' if delay_days>14; ''high_churn'' if total_story_events>50. - success_patterns: ''fast_track'' if lifecycle_efficiency_category=''highly_efficient''; ''exemplary_execution'' if completed, on time, and performance_grade=''excellent''; ''consistent_progress'' if avg_daily_activity_rate>=1.0 and completed; ''rapid_delivery'' if response_time_days<=1 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''complex_mastery'' if complexity_score=3 and lifecycle_health_score>=80; ''urgent_success'' if urgency_score>=4 and delay_days=0. - improvement_opportunities: ''faster_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>72; ''increase_engagement'' if activity_level in (''low_activity'',''dormant''); ''improve_time_management'' if delay_days>0; ''enhance_responsiveness'' if response_time_days>3; ''overall_process_improvement'' if lifecycle_health_score<60; ''add_progress_updates'' if total_story_events<3 and not completed. - complexity_execution_match (first match wins): ''appropriate_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=72; ''appropriate_medium'' if complexity_score=2 and total_lifecycle_hours in 73–336; ''appropriate_complex'' if complexity_score=3 and total_lifecycle_hours in 337–720; ''faster_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours < complexity_score*72; ''slower_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours > complexity_score*240; else ''within_range''. 7) Project context: join staging.stg_asana__project_task on task_id, then staging.stg_asana__project left-joined to intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators to get project_name, team_id, and project_health_score (defaults to 50 when the project exists without indicators). Tasks with multiple projects yield one row per membership; tasks without a project retain a single row with null project fields. 8) User context: join staging.stg_asana__user by casting assignee_user_id to the user_id type to get assignee_name; assignee_performance_grade is always ''unknown'' for matched users. 9) Relative performance vs project: compare lifecycle_health_score to project_health_score and assign: >+20 ''above_project_average''; >+10 ''slightly_above_average''; >= -10 ''project_average''; >= -20 ''slightly_below_average''; else ''below_project_average'' (null project score falls into ''below_project_average''). 10) Data quality validation (is_valid_record): mark false when task_id or task_name is null; lifecycle_health_score outside [0,100]; any of total_lifecycle_hours, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, or avg_daily_activity_rate is negative; or is_completed=true while both completion_timestamp and completed_at are null. Only rows with is_valid_record=true are kept, and results are sorted by lifecycle_health_score descending, then total_lifecycle_hours ascending, then task_id.'

otherwise null, - hours_assigned_to_completion: hours from first_assignment_timestamp to task.completed_at when both exist; otherwise null, - total_lifecycle_hours: hours from task.created_at to task.completed_at if completed, else to the current time, - avg_daily_activity_rate: if lifecycle days from task.created_at to task.completed_at or current time > 0, then total_story_events divided by that day count rounded to two decimals; otherwise equals total_story_events. 5) Classifications and scores: - lifecycle_efficiency_category: • If completed: ''highly_efficient'' when hours_to_assignment<=24 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''efficient'' when <=72 and <=336; ''moderate'' when <=168 and <=720; ''slow_start'' when hours_to_assignment<=336; ''slow_completion'' when hours_assigned_to_completion>720; else ''inefficient''. • If not completed: ''stalled_unassigned'' when hours_to_assignment is null and total_lifecycle_hours>168; ''stalled_assigned'' when hours_to_assignment is not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''urgent_delayed'' when urgency_score>=4 and total_lifecycle_hours>72; else ''in_progress''. - activity_level by avg_daily_activity_rate: >=2.0 ''very_active''; >=1.0 ''active''; >=0.5 ''moderate_activity''; >=0.1 ''low_activity''; else ''dormant''. - lifecycle_health_score: clamp to [0,100] the sum of: • Timeliness: completed on time=40; completed with delay_days<=2=30; <=7=20; completed late>7=10; if not completed and due_date>today=35; due today=25; overdue=5. • Response speed: response_time_days<=1=30; <=3=25; <=7=20; <=14=15; non-null else=10; null=5. • Activity: activity_score*4. • Complexity fit: complexity=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=168=10; complexity=2 and <=336=10; complexity=3 and <=720=10; any task <=72 hours=8; else=5. - current_lifecycle_stage: ''backlog'' (not completed and no assignee); ''newly_assigned'' (not completed, assignee exists, and within 1 day of first assignment or creation if assignment missing); ''active_development'' (not completed, assignee exists, and modified within 7 days); ''stagnant'' (not completed, assignee exists, and last modification >7 days); ''completed_on_time'' (completed with delay_days=0); ''completed_delayed'' (completed with delay_days>0); else ''unknown_state''. 6) Pattern lists (tokens evaluated in fixed order, joined by ", ", and trimmed; empty string if none): - anomaly_patterns: ''delayed_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>336; ''prolonged_execution'' if hours_assigned_to_completion>1440; ''dormant_task'' if avg_daily_activity_rate<0.1 and not completed; ''overengineered_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours>336; ''urgent_ignored'' if urgency_score>=4 and response_time_days>3; ''blocked_subtask'' if parent_task_id not null and total_lifecycle_hours>720; ''severely_delayed'' if delay_days>14; ''high_churn'' if total_story_events>50. - success_patterns: ''fast_track'' if lifecycle_efficiency_category=''highly_efficient''; ''exemplary_execution'' if completed, on time, and performance_grade=''excellent''; ''consistent_progress'' if avg_daily_activity_rate>=1.0 and completed; ''rapid_delivery'' if response_time_days<=1 and hours_assigned_to_completion<=168; ''complex_mastery'' if complexity_score=3 and lifecycle_health_score>=80; ''urgent_success'' if urgency_score>=4 and delay_days=0. - improvement_opportunities: ''faster_assignment'' if hours_to_assignment>72; ''increase_engagement'' if activity_level in (''low_activity'',''dormant''); ''improve_time_management'' if delay_days>0; ''enhance_responsiveness'' if response_time_days>3; ''overall_process_improvement'' if lifecycle_health_score<60; ''add_progress_updates'' if total_story_events<3 and not completed. - complexity_execution_match (first match wins): ''appropriate_simple'' if complexity_score=1 and total_lifecycle_hours<=72; ''appropriate_medium'' if complexity_score=2 and total_lifecycle_hours in 73–336; ''appropriate_complex'' if complexity_score=3 and total_lifecycle_hours in 337–720; ''faster_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours < complexity_score*72; ''slower_than_expected'' if total_lifecycle_hours > complexity_score*240; else ''within_range''. 7) Project context: join staging.stg_asana__project_task on task_id, then staging.stg_asana__project left-joined to intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators to get project_name, team_id, and project_health_score (defaults to 50 when the project exists without indicators). Tasks with multiple projects yield one row per membership; tasks without a project retain a single row with null project fields. 8) User context: join staging.stg_asana__user by casting assignee_user_id to the user_id type to get assignee_name; assignee_performance_grade is always ''unknown'' for matched users. 9) Relative performance vs project: compare lifecycle_health_score to project_health_score and assign: >+20 ''above_project_average''; >+10 ''slightly_above_average''; >= -10 ''project_average''; >= -20 ''slightly_below_average''; else ''below_project_average'' (null project score falls into ''below_project_average''). 10) Data quality validation (is_valid_record): mark false when task_id or task_name is null; lifecycle_health_score outside [0,100]; any of total_lifecycle_hours, hours_to_assignment, hours_assigned_to_completion, or avg_daily_activity_rate is negative; or is_completed=true while both completion_timestamp and completed_at are null. Only rows with is_valid_record=true are kept, and results are sorted by lifecycle_health_score descending, then total_lifecycle_hours ascending, then task_id.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: asana__team
      description: Team details with counts of total and active projects
      grain: One row per team record from staging.stg_asana__team
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__team
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      business_logic: '- Read all rows from the team source as-is (no de-duplication). - Read all rows from the project source as-is. - For each distinct project.team_id, calculate: - number_of_projects: the number of project rows for that team_id (every row counted; duplicates included). - number_of_active_projects: the number of project rows for that team_id where is_archived is false (rows where is_archived is true or NULL are excluded). - Join these metrics to teams by matching team.team_id to project.team_id after converting project.team_id to string; only exact matches contribute metrics. - If a team has no matching metrics, set both counts to 0. - Output team_id, team_name, organization_id, number_of_projects, and number_of_active_projects.'
      columns:
      - name: team_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team identifier from the team source; used to join metrics after converting project team_id to string; duplicates and NULLs are preserved
      - name: team_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team name from the team source; passed through unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: organization_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Organization ID from the team source; passed through unchanged; NULLs preserved
      - name: number_of_projects
        data_type: BIGINT

blocks.original_text:
- name: asana__team_efficiency_metrics
      description: Team-level efficiency, performance, schedule, quality metrics, classifications, and ranks computed from Asana teams, projects, tasks, and users
      grain: One validated row per (team_id, team_name)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__team
      - staging.stg_asana__project
      - intermediate.int_asana__project_health_indicators
      - staging.stg_asana__project_task
      - staging.stg_asana__task
      - staging.stg_asana__user
      business_logic: '- Inputs and filters: - team_base: teams with non-null team_name. - project_base: projects with non-null team_id. - project_health_summary: project health fields with project_size_category defaulted to ''medium_project'' and schedule_forecast sourced from project_forecast. - user_basic_metrics: users with defaults performance_grade=''developing_performer'', workload_category=''normal_workload'', anomaly_flag=''normal'', risk_level=''low_risk'', portfolio_task_count=0, portfolio_overdue_tasks=0. - team_project_summary (per team_id, team_name; projects linked to health by project_id): - Project counts: - total_projects: number of unique projects. - active_projects: unique projects where project_status=''active''; projects without health data are not counted. - completed_projects: unique projects with completion_percentage=100. - overdue_projects: unique projects forecasted ''overdue''. - Averages over health fields (NULLs are ignored; result is NULL when no non-NULL values exist): - avg_project_health and avg_project_performance from overall_health_score. - avg_completion_rate from completion_percentage. - avg_quality_rate from quality_percentage. - avg_risk_percentage from risk_percentage. - Project size distribution: counts of projects by project_size_category among those with health data. - Defaults: total_team_tasks=0, completed_team_tasks=0, active_team_tasks=0, overdue_team_tasks=0, total_project_assignments=0, avg_tasks_per_assignee_across_projects=0.0, avg_project_velocity=0.5, avg_estimated_completion_days=30.0. - Percent metrics: - on_schedule_rate_pct: for teams with at least one unique project, percentage of unique projects forecasted ''on_schedule'', rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0. - quality_completion_rate_pct: for teams with at least one unique completed project, percentage of unique completed projects with overall_health_score>=80, rounded to 2 decimals; otherwise 0. - team_member_performance (per team via projects → project_task → task; only tasks with non-null assignee; users linked by assignee_user_id=user_id): - unique_team_members: number of distinct assignees. - Defaults: avg_member_performance=50.0, avg_member_completion_rate=75.0, avg_member_quality_rate=70.0. - Distributions (counts across task rows; a member appearing on multiple tasks is counted multiple times): top/high/solid/developing/underperformers by performance_grade; high_workload_members by workload_category=''high_workload''; high_risk_members by risk_level=''high_risk''. - avg_tasks_per_member: average of portfolio_task_count over joined task rows; NULL when no rows. - team_efficiency_scoring (join by team_id): - project_management_score (0–25): from on_schedule_rate_pct thresholds (>=90→25, >=75→20, >=60→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]. - quality_management_score (0–25): from avg_quality_rate thresholds (>=85→25, >=70→20, >=55→15, >=40→10, else 5), capped to [0,25]. - collaboration_efficiency_score (0–25): if unique_team_members>0 then based on performer mix shares ((top+high), then (top+high+solid), then underperformers); else 0; capped to [0,25]. - resource_optimization_score (0–25): if unique_team_members>0 then based on shares of high_workload_members and high_risk_members; else 0; capped to [0,25]. - final_team_metrics: - overall_team_efficiency_score: sum of the four sub-scores (0–100). - efficiency_grade: thresholds on overall_team_efficiency_score (>=85 highly_efficient, >=70 efficient, >=55 moderately_efficient, >=40 needs_improvement, else inefficient). - team_size_category: by unique_team_members (<=3 small_team, <=8 medium_team, <=15 large_team, else enterprise_team). - workload_balance_status: by share of high_workload_members (<=10% well_balanced, <=25% mostly_balanced, <=50% unbalanced, else severely_unbalanced); ''no_data'' when no members. - team_maturity_level: by performer mix shares ((top+high) then (top+high+solid) then underperformers); ''undefined'' when no members. - improvement_recommendations: phrases appended in fixed order when conditions are met, then trailing comma/space removed; empty when none. - team_strengths: phrases appended in fixed order when conditions are met, then trailing comma/space removed; empty when none. - validated_team_metrics: - is_valid_record: true only when team_id and team_name are present; overall_team_efficiency_score, avg_completion_rate, avg_quality_rate are within [0,100]; total_projects, completed_projects are non-negative; completed_projects does not exceed total_projects; unique_team_members is non-negative. - Ranks: efficiency_rank by overall_team_efficiency_score descending; performance_rank by avg_project_performance descending; schedule_reliability_rank by on_schedule_rate_pct descending; quality_rank by avg_quality_rate descending; ranks computed before filtering invalid rows. - Output: only rows with is_valid_record=true; ordered by overall_team_efficiency_score descending, then team_id.'

- name: asana__user
      description: User records enriched with task metrics via a left join from users to metrics.
      grain: One row per user_id from staging.stg_asana__user
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__user
      - intermediate.int_asana__user_task_metrics
      business_logic: '- Start with all users from staging.stg_asana__user (user_id, user_name, email). - Left join intermediate.int_asana__user_task_metrics by matching user_id after converting the metrics user_id to text; comparisons preserve exact casing and whitespace. - For number_of_open_tasks and number_of_tasks_completed, use the metric value when present; otherwise output 0. - For avg_close_time_days and avg_close_time_assigned_days, round the metric to the nearest whole day; if the metric is missing or NULL, output NULL. - No additional filters or ordering are applied; only users present in staging.stg_asana__user appear.'
      columns:
      - name: user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User identifier from staging.stg_asana__user; used to join to metrics after converting metrics.user_id to text.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: user_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name passed through from staging.stg_asana__user without transformation.
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email passed through from staging.stg_asana__user without transformation.
      - name: number_of_open_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Open task count from metrics; if missing or NULL, outputs 0.
      - name: number_of_tasks_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Completed task count from metrics; if missing or NULL, outputs 0.
      - name: avg_close_time_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days to close rounded to the nearest whole day; if missing or NULL, outputs NULL.
      - name: avg_close_time_assigned_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from assignment to close rounded to the nearest whole day; if missing or NULL, outputs NULL.

blocks.original_text:
- name: asana__user_performance_dashboard
      description: Comprehensive user performance dashboard with current-month metrics, 6-month baseline comparison, task portfolio stats, composite scoring, and ranks (valid users only)
      grain: One row per user_id (users with non-null user_name and email; final rows must pass is_valid_record)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_asana__user
      - intermediate.int_asana__user_productivity_trends
      - intermediate.int_asana__user_task_metrics
      - intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics
      business_logic: '1) User base: - From staging.stg_asana__user, keep rows where user_name IS NOT NULL and email IS NOT NULL; use fields user_id, user_name, email. 2) Current-month productivity: - From intermediate.int_asana__user_productivity_trends keep activity_month = date_trunc(''month'', current_date) and join to user base on cast(user_id as varchar). - Defaulting for missing current-month rows via COALESCE: - Numeric: total_tasks_assigned, tasks_completed, completion_rate_pct, quality_rate_pct, avg_completion_time, avg_health_score, total_complexity_points -> 0. - Categorical: productivity_tier -> ''no_data''; completion_trend -> ''unknown''; speed_trend -> ''unknown''; anomaly_flag -> ''normal''. 3) 6-month historical baseline (excludes current month): - From intermediate.int_asana__user_productivity_trends where activity_month >= current_date - interval ''6 months'' and activity_month < date_trunc(''month'', current_date); group by user_id; require count(*) >= 3. - Compute arithmetic means: baseline_completion_rate = avg(completion_rate_pct), baseline_completion_time = avg(avg_completion_time), baseline_health_score = avg(avg_health_score), baseline_workload = avg(total_complexity_points); months_of_data = count(*). - Left join to users (cast user_id as varchar) and default missing baseline fields to 0; historical_months defaults to 0 when baseline absent. 4) Baseline deltas: - completion_rate_vs_baseline = round(current_completion_rate - baseline_completion_rate, 2) if baseline_completion_rate > 0 else NULL. - completion_time_vs_baseline_pct = round(((current_avg_completion_time - baseline_completion_time) * 100.0 / baseline_completion_time), 2) if baseline_completion_time > 0 else NULL. - health_score_vs_baseline = round(current_health_score - baseline_health_score, 2) if baseline_health_score > 0 else NULL. 5) Task portfolio (current snapshot): - From intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics where assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL and is_valid_record = true; group by assignee_user_id. - Aggregations used in final output: - Counts: total_assigned_tasks (all rows), active_tasks (task_status_category=''assigned_active''), overdue_tasks (''overdue''), high_priority_tasks (urgency_score >= 4), complex_tasks (complexity_score=3). - Averages: avg_portfolio_health = avg(health_score); avg_urgency_score = avg(urgency_score) over rows with due_date IS NOT NULL. - Averages exclude NULL values; left join to users (cast ids as varchar); default missing portfolio aggregates to 0; no de-duplication beyond grouping key. 6) Composite scoring and categories: - workload_category from total_assigned_tasks: >=20 ''high_workload''; >=10 ''medium_workload''; >=5 ''normal_workload''; >=1 ''light_workload''; else ''no_workload''. - risk_level from overdue share: if overdue_tasks > total_assigned_tasks*0.30 then ''high_risk''; else if > 0.15 then ''medium_risk''; else if > 0 then ''low_risk''; else ''no_risk''. - comprehensive_performance_score = clamp to [0,100] of: 0.30*current_completion_rate + 0.25*current_quality_rate + 0.25*current_health_score + workload component using portfolio_task_count as denominator: least(20, current_tasks_completed * 20.0 / greatest(1, portfolio_task_count)). - improvement_recommendations: evaluate conditions in fixed order and join labels with ", " then trim trailing delimiter: 1) current_completion_rate < 70 -> "improve_completion_rate" 2) current_quality_rate < 60 -> "focus_on_quality" 3) overdue_tasks > 0 -> "address_overdue_tasks" 4) high_priority_tasks > total_assigned_tasks*0.5 -> "prioritize_effectively" 5) current_avg_completion_time > baseline_completion_time*1.5 -> "improve_efficiency" 6) avg_portfolio_health < 60 -> "improve_task_health" - If none apply -> empty string; label order is deterministic as listed; delimiter is ", ". 7) Ranks, grades, and validity: - Compute window ranks (RANK()) over the entire joined set before validity filtering: performance_rank by comprehensive_performance_score DESC; completion_rate_rank by current_completion_rate DESC; quality_rate_rank by current_quality_rate DESC; portfolio_health_rank by portfolio_avg_health DESC. Ties share the same rank; gaps may occur. Because ranks are computed pre-filter, final ranks among valid rows may have gaps. - performance_grade by comprehensive_performance_score: >=85 top_performer; >=70 high_performer; >=55 solid_performer; >=40 developing_performer; >=25 needs_improvement; else requires_support. - is_valid_record = true iff: user_id and user_name are non-null; comprehensive_performance_score in [0,100]; current_completion_rate and current_quality_rate in [0,100]; portfolio_task_count >= 0. - Final output filters is_valid_record = true and orders by comprehensive_performance_score DESC, user_id.'
      columns:
      - name: user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User identifier; grouping key (one row per valid user)
      - name: user_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User display name from staging.stg_asana__user (non-null)
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User email from staging.stg_asana__user (non-null)
      - name: current_tasks_assigned
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current-month total tasks assigned from productivity trends; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: current_tasks_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Current-month tasks completed from productivity trends; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: current_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Current-month completion rate (0–100); used in scoring and rank; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: current_quality_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Current-month quality rate (0–100); used in scoring and rank; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: current_avg_completion_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Current-month average task completion time in days; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: current_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Current-month average task health (0–100); defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: current_workload
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Current-month total complexity points (workload proxy); defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: current_productivity_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current-month productivity tier from trends; defaults to 'no_data' when missing
      - name: baseline_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean completion rate over the prior 6 months (excludes current; requires ≥3 months; else 0)
      - name: baseline_completion_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean completion time (days) over the prior 6 months (excludes current; requires ≥3 months; else 0)
      - name: baseline_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean health score over the prior 6 months (excludes current; requires ≥3 months; else 0)
      - name: baseline_workload
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean total complexity points over the prior 6 months (excludes current; requires ≥3 months; else 0)
      - name: historical_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of months contributing to baseline (0 when baseline not available due to <3 months)
      - name: completion_rate_vs_baseline
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute difference vs baseline completion rate (rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if baseline ≤ 0)
      - name: completion_time_vs_baseline_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs baseline completion time (rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if baseline ≤ 0)
      - name: health_score_vs_baseline
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute difference vs baseline health score (rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if baseline ≤ 0)
      - name: active_tasks_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Open task count from user_task_metrics; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: avg_task_resolution_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from creation to close from user_task_metrics; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: avg_assigned_resolution_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from assignment to close from user_task_metrics; defaults to 0 when missing
      - name: completion_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Completion-rate trend label from trends; defaults to 'unknown' when missing
      - name: speed_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Completion-speed trend label from trends; defaults to 'unknown' when missing
      - name: anomaly_flag
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Anomaly flag from trends; defaults to 'normal' when missing
      - name: portfolio_task_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total valid tasks assigned in portfolio aggregation; no de-duplication; defaults to 0
      - name: portfolio_active_tasks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of tasks with status 'assigned_active' in portfolio; defaults to 0
      - name: portfolio_overdue_tasks
