output.equality_policy: exact CAST AS VARCHAR per row; no trim/case/numeric/date normalization; both NULL ignored; at least one nonnull equal row; one-sided NULL differs

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN portfolio_task_count >= 20 THEN 'high_workload' WHEN portfolio_task_count >= 10 THEN 'medium_workload' WHEN portfolio_task_count >= 5 THEN 'normal_workload' WHEN portfolio_task_count >= 1 THEN 'light_workload' ELSE 'no_workload' END

CASE WHEN portfolio_task_count > 0 AND portfolio_overdue_tasks > portfolio_task_count * 0.3 THEN 'high_risk' WHEN portfolio_task_count > 0 AND portfolio_overdue_tasks > portfolio_task_count * 0.15 THEN 'medium_risk' WHEN portfolio_overdue_tasks > 0 THEN 'low_risk' ELSE 'no_risk' END

CAST(LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 0.3 * current_completion_rate + 0.25 * current_quality_rate + 0.25 * current_health_score + LEAST(20, current_tasks_completed * 20.0 / GREATEST(1, portfolio_task_count)))) AS DOUBLE)

CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN current_completion_rate < 70 THEN 'improve_completion_rate' END, CASE WHEN current_quality_rate < 60 THEN 'focus_on_quality' END, CASE WHEN portfolio_overdue_tasks > 0 THEN 'address_overdue_tasks' END, CASE WHEN portfolio_high_priority > portfolio_task_count * 0.5 THEN 'prioritize_effectively' END, CASE WHEN current_avg_completion_time > baseline_completion_time * 1.5 THEN 'improve_efficiency' END, CASE WHEN portfolio_avg_health < 60 THEN 'improve_task_health' END)

CASE WHEN comprehensive_performance_score >= 85 THEN 'top_performer' WHEN comprehensive_performance_score >= 70 THEN 'high_performer' WHEN comprehensive_performance_score >= 55 THEN 'solid_performer' WHEN comprehensive_performance_score >= 40 THEN 'developing_performer' WHEN comprehensive_performance_score >= 25 THEN 'needs_improvement' ELSE 'requires_support' END

references.name: staging.stg_asana__user
references.line_text: business_logic: '1) User base: - From staging.stg_asana__user, keep rows where user_name IS NOT NULL and email IS NOT NULL; use fields user_id, user_name, email. 2) Current-month productivity: - From intermediate.int_asana__user_productivity_trends keep activity_month = date_trunc(''month'', current_date) and join to user base on cast(user_id as varchar). - Defaulting for missing current-month rows via COALESCE: - Numeric: total_tasks_assigned, tasks_completed, completion_rate_pct, quality_rate_pct, avg_completion_time, avg_health_score, total_complexity_points -> 0. - Categorical: productivity_tier -> ''no_data''; completion_trend -> ''unknown''; speed_trend -> ''unknown''; anomaly_flag -> ''normal''. 3) 6-month historical baseline (excludes current month): - From intermediate.int_asana__user_productivity_trends where activity_month >= current_date - interval ''6 months'' and activity_month < date_trunc(''month'', current_date); group by user_id; require count(*) >= 3. - Compute arithmetic means: baseline_completion_rate = avg(completion_rate_pct), baseline_completion_time = avg(avg_completion_time), baseline_health_score = avg(avg_health_score), baseline_workload = avg(total_complexity_points); months_of_data = count(*). - Left join to users (cast user_id as varchar) and default missing baseline fields to 0; historical_months defaults to 0 when baseline absent. 4) Baseline deltas: - completion_rate_vs_baseline = round(current_completion_rate - baseline_completion_rate, 2) if baseline_completion_rate > 0 else NULL. - completion_time_vs_baseline_pct = round(((current_avg_completion_time - baseline_completion_time) * 100.0 / baseline_completion_time), 2) if baseline_completion_time > 0 else NULL. - health_score_vs_baseline = round(current_health_score - baseline_health_score, 2) if baseline_health_score > 0 else NULL. 5) Task portfolio (current snapshot): - From intermediate.int_asana__task_performance_metrics where assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL and is_valid_record = true; group by assignee_user_id. - Aggregations used in final output: - Counts: total_assigned_tasks (all rows), active_tasks (task_status_category=''assigned_active''), overdue_tasks (''overdue''), high_priority_tasks (urgency_score >= 4), complex_tasks (complexity_score=3). - Averages: avg_portfolio_health = avg(health_score); avg_urgency_score = avg(urgency_score) over rows with due_date IS NOT NULL. - Averages exclude NULL values; left join to users (cast ids as varchar); default missing portfolio aggregates to 0; no de-duplication beyond grouping key. 6) Composite scoring and categories: - workload_category from total_assigned_tasks: >=20 ''high_workload''; >=10 ''medium_workload''; >=5 ''normal_workload''; >=1 ''light_workload''; else ''no_workload''. - risk_level from overdue share: if overdue_tasks > total_assigned_tasks*0.30 then ''high_risk''; else if > 0.15 then ''medium_risk''; else if > 0 then ''low_risk''; else ''no_risk''. - comprehensive_performance_score = clamp to [0,100] of: 0.30*current_completion_rate + 0.25*current_quality_rate + 0.25*current_health_score + workload component using portfolio_task_count as denominator: least(20, current_tasks_completed * 20.0 / greatest(1, portfolio_task_count)). - improvement_recommendations: evaluate conditions in fixed order and join labels with ", " then trim trailing delimiter: 1) current_completion_rate < 70 -> "improve_completion_rate" 2) current_quality_rate < 60 -> "focus_on_quality" 3) overdue_tasks > 0 -> "address_overdue_tasks" 4) high_priority_tasks > total_assigned_tasks*0.5 -> "prioritize_effectively" 5) current_avg_completion_time > baseline_completion_time*1.5 -> "improve_efficiency" 6) avg_portfolio_health < 60 -> "improve_task_health" - If none apply -> empty string; label order is deterministic as listed; delimiter is ", ". 7) Ranks, grades, and validity: - Compute window ranks (RANK()) over the entire joined set before validity filtering: performance_rank by comprehensive_performance_score DESC; completion_rate_rank by current_completion_rate DESC; quality_rate_rank by current_quality_rate DESC; portfolio_health_rank by portfolio_avg_health DESC. Ties share the same rank; gaps may occur. Because ranks are computed pre-filter, final ranks among valid rows may have gaps. - performance_grade by comprehensive_performance_score: >=85 top_performer; >=70 high_performer; >=55 solid_performer; >=40 developing_performer; >=25 needs_improvement; else requires_support. - is_valid_record = true iff: user_id and user_name are non-null; comprehensive_performance_score in [0,100]; current_completion_rate and current_quality_rate in [0,100]; portfolio_task_count >= 0. - Final output filters is_valid_record = true and orders by comprehensive_performance_score DESC, user_id.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: stg_asana__project
      description: "Standardized project entities with validated dates, statuses, and ownership relationships"
      source_table: "raw.project_data"
      columns:
        - name: project_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null, unique]
        - name: is_archived
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: current_status
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "current_status = LOWER(TRIM(current_status))"
              on_failure: correct
              description: "Standardize status to lowercase"
            - rule: "current_status IS NULL OR current_status IN ('on_track', 'at_risk', 'off_track', 'on_hold', 'complete')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
              description: "Status must be one of valid project statuses"
        - name: due_date
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: modified_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: project_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "project_name = TRIM(project_name)"
              on_failure: correct
              description: "Remove whitespace from project names"
            - rule: "LENGTH(project_name) >= 1"
              on_failure: delete_row
              description: "Project name cannot be empty"
        - name: owner_user_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: is_public
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: team_id
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: workspace_id
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: notes
          data_type: VARCHAR

constant_nonnull_columns.value_representation: DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR, exact, no normalization

          data_type: BOOLEAN
